paragraphs.text: Now even a first [covenant] had ordinances of divine service, and its sanctuary, [a sanctuary] of this world.
paragraphs.original: Εἶχε μὲν οὖν ἡ πρώτη δικαιώματα λατρείας τό τε ἅγιον κοσμικόν.
paragraphs.translit: Eiche men oun hē prōtē dikaiōmata latreias to te hagion kosmikon.

paragraphs.text: For there was a tabernacle prepared, the first, wherein [were] the candlestick, and the table, and the showbread; which is called the Holy place.
paragraphs.original: σκηνὴ γὰρ κατεσκευάσθη ἡ πρώτη ἐν ᾗ ἥ τε λυχνία καὶ ἡ τράπεζα καὶ ἡ πρόθεσις τῶν ἄρτων, ἥτις λέγεται Ἅγια·
paragraphs.translit: skēnē gar kateskeuasthē hē prōtē en hē hē te lychnia kai hē trapeza kai hē prothesis tōn artōn, hētis legetai Hagia·

paragraphs.text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holy of holies;
paragraphs.original: μετὰ δὲ τὸ δεύτερον καταπέτασμα σκηνὴ ἡ λεγομένη Ἅγια Ἁγίων,
paragraphs.translit: meta de to deuteron katapetasma skēnē hē legomenē Hagia Hagiōn,

paragraphs.text: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein [was] a golden pot holding the manna, and Aaron`s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
paragraphs.original: χρυσοῦν ἔχουσα θυμιατήριον καὶ τὴν κιβωτὸν τῆς διαθήκης περικεκαλυμμένην πάντοθεν χρυσίῳ, ἐν ᾗ στάμνος χρυσῆ ἔχουσα τὸ μάννα καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος Ἀαρὼν ἡ βλαστήσασα καὶ αἱ πλάκες τῆς διαθήκης,
paragraphs.translit: chrysoun echousa thymiatērion kai tēn kibōton tēs diathēkēs perikekalymmenēn pantothen chrysiō, en hē stamnos chrysē echousa to manna kai hē rhabdos Aarōn hē blastēsasa kai hai plakes tēs diathēkēs,

paragraphs.text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy-seat; of which things we cannot now speak severally.
paragraphs.original: ὑπεράνω δὲ αὐτῆς Χερουβὶν δόξης κατασκιάζοντα τὸ ἱλαστήριον· περὶ ὧν οὐκ ἔστιν νῦν λέγειν κατὰ μέρος.
paragraphs.translit: hyperanō de autēs Cheroubin doxēs kataskiazonta to hilastērion· peri hōn ouk estin nyn legein kata meros.

paragraphs.text: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services;
paragraphs.original: Τούτων δὲ οὕτως κατεσκευασμένων, εἰς μὲν τὴν πρώτην σκηνὴν διὰ παντὸς εἰσίασιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὰς λατρείας ἐπιτελοῦντες,
paragraphs.translit: Toutōn de houtōs kateskeuasmenōn, eis men tēn prōtēn skēnēn dia pantos eisiasin hoi hiereis tas latreias epitelountes,

paragraphs.text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offereth for himself, and for the errors of the people:
paragraphs.original: εἰς δὲ τὴν δευτέραν ἅπαξ τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ μόνος ὁ ἀρχιερεύς, οὐ χωρὶς αἵματος, ὃ προσφέρει ὑπὲρ ἑαυτοῦ καὶ τῶν τοῦ λαοῦ ἀγνοημάτων,
paragraphs.translit: eis de tēn deuteran hapax tou eniautou monos ho archiereus, ou chōris haimatos, ho prospherei hyper heautou kai tōn tou laou agnoēmatōn,

paragraphs.text: the Holy Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holy place hath not yet been made manifest, while the first tabernacle is yet standing;
paragraphs.original: τοῦτο δηλοῦντος τοῦ πνεύματος τοῦ ἁγίου, μήπω πεφανερῶσθαι τὴν τῶν ἁγίων ὁδὸν ἔτι τῆς πρώτης σκηνῆς ἐχούσης στάσιν,
paragraphs.translit: touto dēlountos tou pneumatos tou hagiou, mēpō pephanerōsthai tēn tōn hagiōn hodon eti tēs prōtēs skēnēs echousēs stasin,

paragraphs.text: which [is] a figure for the time present; according to which are offered both gifts and sacrifices that cannot, as touching the conscience, make the worshipper perfect,
paragraphs.original: ἥτις παραβολὴ εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τὸν ἐνεστηκότα, καθʼ ἣν δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίαι προσφέρονται μὴ δυνάμεναι κατὰ συνείδησιν τελειῶσαι τὸν λατρεύοντα,
paragraphs.translit: hētis parabolē eis ton kairon ton enestēkota, kathʼ hēn dōra te kai thysiai prospherontai mē dynamenai kata syneidēsin teleiōsai ton latreuonta,

paragraphs.text: [being] only (with meats and drinks and divers washings) carnal ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
paragraphs.original: μόνον ἐπὶ βρώμασιν καὶ πόμασιν καὶ διαφόροις βαπτισμοῖς, δικαιώματα σαρκὸς μέχρι καιροῦ διορθώσεως ἐπικείμενα.
paragraphs.translit: monon epi brōmasin kai pomasin kai diaphorois baptismois, dikaiōmata sarkos mechri kairou diorthōseōs epikeimena.

paragraphs.text: But Christ having come a high priest of the good things to come, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
paragraphs.original: Χριστὸς δὲ παραγενόμενος ἀρχιερεὺς τῶν γενομένων ἀγαθῶν διὰ τῆς μείζονος καὶ τελειοτέρας σκηνῆς οὐ χειροποιήτου, τοῦτʼ ἔστιν οὐ ταύτης τῆς κτίσεως,
paragraphs.translit: Christos de paragenomenos archiereus tōn genomenōn agathōn dia tēs meizonos kai teleioteras skēnēs ou cheiropoiētou, toutʼ estin ou tautēs tēs ktiseōs,

paragraphs.text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ διʼ αἵματος τράγων καὶ μόσχων διὰ δὲ τοῦ ἰδίου αἵματος, εἰσῆλθεν ἐφάπαξ εἰς τὰ ἅγια, αἰωνίαν λύτρωσιν εὑράμενος.
paragraphs.translit: oude diʼ haimatos tragōn kai moschōn dia de tou idiou haimatos, eisēlthen ephapax eis ta hagia, aiōnian lytrōsin heuramenos.

paragraphs.text: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling them that have been defiled, sanctify unto the cleanness of the flesh:
paragraphs.original: εἰ γὰρ τὸ αἷμα τράγων καὶ ταύρων καὶ σποδὸς δαμάλεως ῥαντίζουσα τοὺς κεκοινωμένους ἁγιάζει πρὸς τὴν τῆς σαρκὸς καθαρότητα,
paragraphs.translit: ei gar to haima tragōn kai taurōn kai spodos damaleōs rhantizousa tous kekoinōmenous hagiazei pros tēn tēs sarkos katharotēta,

paragraphs.text: how much more shall the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish unto God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?
paragraphs.original: πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ αἷμα τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὃς διὰ πνεύματος αἰωνίου ἑαυτὸν προσήνεγκεν ἄμωμον τῷ θεῷ, καθαριεῖ τὴν συνείδησιν ἡμῶν ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων εἰς τὸ λατρεύειν θεῷ ζῶντι.
paragraphs.translit: posō mallon to haima tou Christou, hos dia pneumatos aiōniou heauton prosēnenken amōmon tō theō, kathariei tēn syneidēsin hēmōn apo nekrōn ergōn eis to latreuein theō zōnti.

paragraphs.text: And for this cause he is the mediator of a new covenant, that a death having taken place for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, they that have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ διὰ τοῦτο διαθήκης καινῆς μεσίτης ἐστίν, ὅπως θανάτου γενομένου εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῶν ἐπὶ τῇ πρώτῃ διαθήκῃ παραβάσεων τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν λάβωσιν οἱ κεκλημένοι τῆς αἰωνίου κληρονομίας.
paragraphs.translit: Kai dia touto diathēkēs kainēs mesitēs estin, hopōs thanatou genomenou eis apolytrōsin tōn epi tē prōtē diathēkē parabaseōn tēn epangelian labōsin hoi keklēmenoi tēs aiōniou klēronomias.

paragraphs.text: For where a testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him that made it.
paragraphs.original: ὅπου γὰρ διαθήκη, θάνατον ἀνάγκη φέρεσθαι τοῦ διαθεμένου·
paragraphs.translit: hopou gar diathēkē, thanaton anankē pheresthai tou diathemenou·

paragraphs.text: For a testament is of force where there hath been death: for it doth never avail while he that made it liveth.
paragraphs.original: διαθήκη γὰρ ἐπὶ νεκροῖς βεβαία, ἐπεὶ μήποτε ἰσχύει ὅτε ζῇ ὁ διαθέμενος.
paragraphs.translit: diathēkē gar epi nekrois bebaia, epei mēpote ischyei hote zē ho diathemenos.

paragraphs.text: Wherefore even the first [covenant] hath not been dedicated without blood.
paragraphs.original: ὅθεν οὐδὲ ἡ πρώτη χωρὶς αἵματος ἐγκεκαίνισται·
paragraphs.translit: hothen oude hē prōtē chōris haimatos enkekainistai·

paragraphs.text: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses unto all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
paragraphs.original: λαληθείσης γὰρ πάσης ἐντολῆς κατὰ τὸν νόμον ὑπὸ Μωϋσέως παντὶ τῷ λαῷ, λαβὼν τὸ αἷμα τῶν μόσχων μετὰ ὕδατος καὶ ἐρίου κοκκίνου καὶ ὑσσώπου αὐτό τε τὸ βιβλίον καὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν ἐράντισεν,
paragraphs.translit: lalētheisēs gar pasēs entolēs kata ton nomon hypo Mōyseōs panti tō laō, labōn to haima tōn moschōn meta hydatos kai eriou kokkinou kai hyssōpou auto te to biblion kai panta ton laon erantisen,

paragraphs.text: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God commanded to you-ward.
paragraphs.original: λέγων· Τοῦτο τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης ἧς ἐνετείλατο πρὸς ὑμᾶς ὁ θεός·
paragraphs.translit: legōn· Touto to haima tēs diathēkēs hēs eneteilato pros hymas ho theos·

paragraphs.text: Moreover the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry he sprinkled in like manner with the blood.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν δὲ καὶ πάντα τὰ σκεύη τῆς λειτουργίας τῷ αἵματι ὁμοίως ἐράντισεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai tēn skēnēn de kai panta ta skeuē tēs leitourgias tō haimati homoiōs erantisen.

paragraphs.text: And according to the law, I may almost say, all things are cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
paragraphs.original: καὶ σχεδὸν ἐν αἵματι πάντα καθαρίζεται κατὰ τὸν νόμον, καὶ χωρὶς αἱματεκχυσίας οὐ γίνεται ἄφεσις.
paragraphs.translit: kai schedon en haimati panta katharizetai kata ton nomon, kai chōris haimatekchysias ou ginetai aphesis.

paragraphs.text: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
paragraphs.original: Ἀνάγκη οὖν τὰ μὲν ὑποδείγματα τῶν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς τούτοις καθαρίζεσθαι, αὐτὰ δὲ τὰ ἐπουράνια κρείττοσι θυσίαις παρὰ ταύτας.
paragraphs.translit: Anankē oun ta men hypodeigmata tōn en tois ouranois toutois katharizesthai, auta de ta epourania kreittosi thysiais para tautas.

paragraphs.text: For Christ entered not into a holy place made with hands, like in pattern to the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear before the face of God for us:
paragraphs.original: οὐ γὰρ εἰς χειροποίητα εἰσῆλθεν ἅγια Χριστός, ἀντίτυπα τῶν ἀληθινῶν, ἀλλʼ εἰς αὐτὸν τὸν οὐρανόν, νῦν ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ προσώπῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: ou gar eis cheiropoiēta eisēlthen hagia Christos, antitypa tōn alēthinōn, allʼ eis auton ton ouranon, nyn emphanisthēnai tō prosōpō tou theou hyper hēmōn·

paragraphs.text: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place year by year with blood not his own;
paragraphs.original: οὐδʼ ἵνα πολλάκις προσφέρῃ ἑαυτόν, ὥσπερ ὁ ἀρχιερεὺς εἰσέρχεται εἰς τὰ ἅγια κατʼ ἐνιαυτὸν ἐν αἵματι ἀλλοτρίῳ,
paragraphs.translit: oudʼ hina pollakis prospherē heauton, hōsper ho archiereus eiserchetai eis ta hagia katʼ eniauton en haimati allotriō,

paragraphs.text: else must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once at the end of the ages hath he been manifested to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
paragraphs.original: ἐπεὶ ἔδει αὐτὸν πολλάκις παθεῖν ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου· νυνὶ δὲ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ συντελείᾳ τῶν αἰώνων εἰς ἀθέτησιν ἁμαρτίας διὰ τῆς θυσίας αὐτοῦ πεφανέρωται.
paragraphs.translit: epei edei auton pollakis pathein apo katabolēs kosmou· nyni de hapax epi synteleia tōn aiōnōn eis athetēsin hamartias dia tēs thysias autou pephanerōtai.

paragraphs.text: And inasmuch as it is appointed unto men once to die, and after this [cometh] judgment;
paragraphs.original: καὶ καθʼ ὅσον ἀπόκειται τοῖς ἀνθρώποις ἅπαξ ἀποθανεῖν, μετὰ δὲ τοῦτο κρίσις,
paragraphs.translit: kai kathʼ hoson apokeitai tois anthrōpois hapax apothanein, meta de touto krisis,

paragraphs.text: so Christ also, having been once offered to bear the sins of many, shall appear a second time, apart from sin, to them that wait for him, unto salvation.
paragraphs.original: οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστός, ἅπαξ προσενεχθεὶς εἰς τὸ πολλῶν ἀνενεγκεῖν ἁμαρτίας, ἐκ δευτέρου χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας ὀφθήσεται τοῖς αὐτὸν ἀπεκδεχομένοις εἰς σωτηρίαν.
paragraphs.translit: houtōs kai ho Christos, hapax prosenechtheis eis to pollōn anenenkein hamartias, ek deuterou chōris hamartias ophthēsetai tois auton apekdechomenois eis sōtērian.
